title: Sketchpad Platform Refactor
description: Rename ProductRuntime to Platform; replace board/scene3d with table/puzzle2d/puzzle3d/puzzle5d/cad/panel component kinds; rewrite sketchpad as declarative Platform instance with home/kit table + kit diagram slice.
summary: Continued pure-TS sketchpad platform refactor: fixed navigateSketchpadTo to require platform while SketchpadShellController.navigateTo updates shell navigationPath without a mounted platform (tests/headless). closeKit now revokeStore so getKitStore is undefined after close. createTemporaryKit/openKit use navigateTo. Kit diagram snapshot includes types and designs; design scene and type CAD snapshots show kit labels. Added framework/core Controller.revokeStore with test. Sketchpad vitest: 7 tests (closeKit, createTemporaryKit, findDesignInKit). All sketchpad tsc + vitest and framework/core vitest pass.
